title: Željezničar se rastao s trenerom Davidom Muslerom
Željezničar parts ways with coach David Muslera
body: Španski trener David Muslera više nije trener Fudbalskog kluba Željezničar iz Sarajeva.
Spanish coach David Muslera is no longer the coach of Željezničar Football Club from Sarajevo.
Klub je to objavio u subotu, nakon teškog poraza od Borca na Grbavici.
The club announced it on Saturday, after a heavy defeat to Borac at Grbavica.
Borac je u toj utakmici pobijedio rezultatom 4:0.
Borac won that match 4-0.
Muslera je sezonu počeo dobro, s pobjedom protiv BSK-a u prvom kolu Premijer lige.
Muslera started the season well, with a win against BSK in the first round of the Premier League.
Posljednju pobjedu u ligi ostvario je 9. septembra, kada je Željezničar u derbiju pobijedio Sarajevo 2:0.
He got his last league win on 9 September, when Željezničar beat Sarajevo 2-0 in the derby.
Nakon toga klub dva mjeseca nije pobijedio u ligi, a imao je tri neriješena rezultata i četiri poraza.
After that the club did not win in the league for two months, and it had three draws and four defeats.
Jedinu radost u tom periodu donijela je pobjeda 1:0 protiv Slobode u Kupu BiH.
The only joy in that period was a 1-0 win against Sloboda in the BiH Cup.
Ukupno je vodio tim u 15 utakmica, s 4 pobjede, 4 remija i 7 poraza.
In total he led the team in 15 matches, with 4 wins, 4 draws and 7 defeats.
U saopćenju se klub zahvalio Musleri na njegovom radu od početka sezone.
In a statement the club thanked Muslera for his work since the start of the season.
Također su mu poželjeli puno uspjeha u nastavku trenerske karijere.
They also wished him a lot of success in the rest of his coaching career.
Nakon utakmice Muslera je rekao da se vidjela razlika u kvaliteti dva kluba.
After the match Muslera said that the difference in quality between the two clubs was visible.

title: Leeds s Muharemovićem pobijedio Chelsea 4:1 u Londonu
Leeds with Muharemović beat Chelsea 4-1 in London
body: Leeds United je u subotu u Londonu pobijedio Chelsea rezultatom 4:1.
Leeds United beat Chelsea 4-1 in London on Saturday.
Važnu ulogu u pobjedi imao je i reprezentativac BiH Tarik Muharemović.
BiH national team player Tarik Muharemović also played an important role in the win.
On je igrao od prve minute u odbrani s tri igrača i bio je jedan od najboljih na terenu.
He played from the first minute in a three-man defence and was one of the best on the pitch.
Chelsea je poveo u 25. minuti, kada je gol postigao Emmanuel Emeghe.
Chelsea took the lead in the 25th minute, when Emmanuel Emeghe scored.
Samo tri minute kasnije Noah Okafor je izjednačio rezultat.
Only three minutes later Noah Okafor equalised.
Muharemović je pred kraj prvog poluvremena zabio gol, ali ga je sudija poništio zbog ofsajda njegovog saigrača.
Muharemović scored a goal near the end of the first half, but the referee disallowed it because of a teammate's offside.
U drugom poluvremenu Dominic Calvert-Lewin je u 53. minuti postigao gol iz penala.
In the second half Dominic Calvert-Lewin scored a penalty in the 53rd minute.
Okafor je zatim zabio svoj drugi gol, a Brenden Aaronson je u nadoknadi postavio konačnih 4:1.
Okafor then scored his second goal, and Brenden Aaronson made the final score 4-1 in stoppage time.
Leeds je nakon ove pobjede šesti na tabeli sa 17 bodova i nalazi se ispred Chelseaja.
After this win Leeds is sixth in the table with 17 points and is ahead of Chelsea.
Klub sada ima realnu šansu da ove sezone igra u evropskim takmičenjima.
The club now has a realistic chance to play in European competitions this season.
Muharemović je u Leeds došao ovog ljeta iz Sassuola za 34 miliona funti.
Muharemović came to Leeds this summer from Sassuolo for 34 million pounds.

title: Borac na Grbavici pobijedio Željezničar rezultatom 4:0
Borac beat Željezničar 4-0 at Grbavica
body: Fudbaleri Borca su u subotu na Grbavici pobijedili Željezničar rezultatom 4:0.
Borac's footballers beat Željezničar 4-0 at Grbavica on Saturday.
Utakmica je igrana u 14. kolu Premijer lige BiH.
The match was played in round 14 of the BiH Premier League.
Borac, koji je aktuelni prvak, bio je bolji od prve minute.
Borac, the current champion, was better from the first minute.
Prvi gol je u 23. minuti postigao mladi Matej Deket, udarcem s više od 25 metara.
Young Matej Deket scored the first goal in the 23rd minute, with a shot from more than 25 metres.
Do 40. minute Borac je imao 11 udaraca, a Željezničar samo jedan.
By the 40th minute Borac had 11 shots, and Željezničar only one.
U drugom poluvremenu Sebastian Herrera je u 72. minuti zabio gol iz slobodnog udarca.
In the second half Sebastian Herrera scored from a free kick in the 72nd minute.
Nakon toga je Amer Hiroš, bivši igrač Željezničara, postigao još dva gola.
After that Amer Hiroš, a former Željezničar player, scored two more goals.
Hiroš nije slavio golove iz poštovanja prema svom starom klubu.
Hiroš did not celebrate the goals out of respect for his old club.
Željezničar više od dva mjeseca nije pobijedio u ligi.
Željezničar has not won in the league for more than two months.
Prije ove utakmice bio je šesti sa 13 bodova, a sada je pao na sedmo mjesto.
Before this match it was sixth with 13 points, and now it has dropped to seventh place.
Klub je samo dva boda iznad zone ispadanja, a Velež ga je prestigao u ovom kolu.
The club is only two points above the relegation zone, and Velež overtook it in this round.
Nakon poraza klub se rastao s trenerom Davidom Muslerom.
After the defeat the club parted ways with coach David Muslera.

title: Trump: Želim trajan sporazum s Iranom
Trump: I want a lasting agreement with Iran
body: Američki predsjednik Donald Trump rekao je da mu nikad nije bilo previše stalo do režima u Iranu.
US President Donald Trump said he never cared too much about the regime in Iran.
To je izjavio u subotu u intervjuu za televiziju Fox News.
He said this on Saturday in an interview with Fox News.
U intervjuu je govorio o svom planu za završetak rata s Iranom.
In the interview he talked about his plan to end the war with Iran.
Trump je rekao da želi trajan sporazum koji bi Iranu zabranio razvoj nuklearnog oružja.
Trump said he wants a lasting agreement that would ban Iran from developing nuclear weapons.
Kada su ga pitali hoće li iranska vlast preživjeti rat, rekao je da je već smijenio dva režima.
When asked whether the Iranian government will survive the war, he said he had already removed two regimes.
On je to nazvao konačnom promjenom režima.
He called that the ultimate regime change.
Sadašnje iransko rukovodstvo je, prema njegovim riječima, vjerovatno razumnije, ali je s njim vrlo teško.
According to him, the current Iranian leadership is probably more reasonable, but it is very difficult to deal with.
Rekao je i da Iran prihvati dogovore, a onda ih već sljedeći dan prekrši.
He also said that Iran accepts deals and then breaks them the very next day.
Trump želi da sporazum važi i nakon što on ode s funkcije.
Trump wants the agreement to remain valid even after he leaves office.
Dodao je da sporazum mora važiti i ako za 15 ili 20 godina dođe nesposoban predsjednik.
He added that the agreement must hold even if an incompetent president comes in 15 or 20 years.
U februaru je Trump javno podržao promjenu režima u Iranu.
In February Trump publicly supported regime change in Iran.
Međutim, u junu je rekao da mu promjena režima nikad nije bila važna.
However, in June he said that regime change had never been important to him.

title: Studija: Više od 84 posto pasa pokazuje strah
Study: More than 84 percent of dogs show fear
body: Nova američka studija pokazala je da više od 84 posto pasa ima barem blage znakove straha ili anksioznosti.
A new American study has shown that more than 84 percent of dogs have at least mild signs of fear or anxiety.
Istraživanje je vodila profesorica Bonnie Beaver s Univerziteta Texas A&M.
The research was led by Professor Bonnie Beaver from Texas A&M University.
Rezultati su objavljeni u naučnom časopisu Veterinary Research Communications.
The results were published in the scientific journal Veterinary Research Communications.
Naučnici su koristili podatke o više od 43.000 pasa iz velikog projekta Dog Aging Project.
The scientists used data on more than 43,000 dogs from the large Dog Aging Project.
U tom projektu vlasnici opisuju zdravlje i ponašanje svojih pasa.
In that project owners describe the health and behaviour of their dogs.
Vlasnici su kao najčešći razlog straha naveli nepoznate ljude i nepoznate pse.
Owners named unfamiliar people and unfamiliar dogs as the most common cause of fear.
Strah od kupanja ili rezanja noktiju nije uračunat u rezultate.
Fear of bathing or nail trimming was not counted in the results.
Autori ipak kažu da to ne znači da većina pasa ima poremećaj anksioznosti.
The authors say, however, that this does not mean most dogs have an anxiety disorder.
Beaver je rekla da je to ponašanje koje je većina vlasnika već vidjela.
Beaver said that this is behaviour most owners have already seen.
Dugotrajni stres može oslabiti imunitet i skratiti život psa.
Long-term stress can weaken the immune system and shorten a dog's life.
Ako se strah ne prati, može postati jači i dovesti do agresije.
If fear is not monitored, it can become stronger and lead to aggression.
Zato ona savjetuje vlasnicima da se obrate stručnjaku kada ponašanje postane jače ili traje duže.
That is why she advises owners to turn to an expert when the behaviour becomes stronger or lasts longer.

title: Frenkie uskoro objavljuje novi album Prime
Frenkie will soon release a new album, Prime
body: Reper iz BiH Adnan Hamidović Frenkie najavio je svoj jedanaesti samostalni album.
Bosnian rapper Adnan Hamidović Frenkie has announced his eleventh solo album.
Album se zove Prime i izlazi u petak, 27. novembra, na svim platformama.
The album is called Prime and comes out on Friday, 27 November, on all platforms.
Dan ranije, u četvrtak navečer, bit će objavljeni prvi singl i spot.
A day earlier, on Thursday evening, the first single and music video will be released.
Njegov posljednji album Manifest izašao je prije otprilike dvije godine.
His last album, Manifest, came out about two years ago.
Nedavno je Frenkie iznenadio publiku zajedničkom knjigom s hafizom Nedimom Botićem.
Recently Frenkie surprised the public with a joint book with hafiz Nedim Botić.
Na produkciji albuma radili su Mirza Rahmanović Indigo, Edber Vuranovski Edba i Fikret Hodžić.
Mirza Rahmanović Indigo, Edber Vuranovski Edba and Fikret Hodžić worked on the production of the album.
Novi album je prirodan nastavak njegovog rada, pa bi se mogao svidjeti fanovima Manifesta.
The new album is a natural continuation of his work, so fans of Manifest might like it.
Frenkie je rekao da je ovo njegov najličniji album do sada.
Frenkie said this is his most personal album so far.
Glavna emocija na albumu je melanholija, odnosno tiha tuga.
The main emotion on the album is melancholy, that is, a quiet sadness.
U pjesmi Prime pita se gdje prestaje Frenkie, a gdje počinje Adnan.
In the song Prime he asks where Frenkie ends and where Adnan begins.
Rekao je i da se osjeća kao da je na vrhuncu svoje kreativnosti, pa je zato izabrao taj naziv.
He also said he feels he is at the peak of his creativity, which is why he chose that title.

title: Ana Brnabić i Tomislav Nikolić moraju napustiti državne vile
Ana Brnabić and Tomislav Nikolić must leave state villas
body: Nakon promjene vlasti u Srbiji, Ana Brnabić i Tomislav Nikolić morat će napustiti državne vile u Beogradu.
After the change of government in Serbia, Ana Brnabić and Tomislav Nikolić will have to leave state villas in Belgrade.
Obje vile se nalaze u beogradskom naselju Dedinje.
Both villas are in the Belgrade neighbourhood of Dedinje.
To je portalu Nova.rs rekao jedan izvor.
A source told this to the Nova.rs portal.
Prema izvoru, oni će se morati iseliti kada novi predsjednik države i nova vlada preuzmu dužnost.
According to the source, they will have to move out when the new head of state and the new government take office.
Brnabić živi u bivšoj vili Jovanke Broz, u ulici Aleksandra Karađorđevića 75.
Brnabić lives in the former villa of Jovanka Broz, at Aleksandra Karađorđevića Street 75.
Ona je bila predsjednica Narodne skupštine Srbije.
She was the Speaker of the National Assembly of Serbia.
Dužnost šefa države obavljala je dok nije izabran Aleksandar Čupić.
She acted as head of state until Aleksandar Čupić was elected.
Bivši predsjednik Srbije Nikolić živi u vili u Užičkoj ulici broj 23.
Former Serbian president Nikolić lives in a villa at Užička Street number 23.
Tu vilu je dobio u novembru 2018. godine, nakon promjene jedne vladine uredbe.
He got that villa in November 2018, after a change to a government decree.
Portal Insajder je tada pisao da njeno održavanje mjesečno košta oko 400.000 dinara.
The Insajder portal wrote at the time that its upkeep costs about 400,000 dinars a month.
To je otprilike 3.400 eura.
That is roughly 3,400 euros.
Vlada je tada rekla da taj novac pokriva čišćenje, grijanje i druge troškove.
The government said at the time that this money covers cleaning, heating and other costs.

title: Radovi na 12. transverzali u Sarajevu još nisu završeni
Works on the 12th transversal in Sarajevo are not finished yet
body: Na 12. transverzali u Sarajevu, kod tržnog centra Bingo na Stupu, i dalje se izvode radovi.
Works are still going on at the 12th transversal in Sarajevo, near the Bingo shopping centre in Stup.
Transverzala je nova cesta koja treba povezati Stupsku petlju i ulaz u aerodrom.
The transversal is a new road that is meant to connect the Stup interchange and the airport entrance.
Ugovoreni rok za ovu dionicu, odnosno dio ceste dug 380 metara, istekao je u septembru.
The agreed deadline for this section, that is a part of the road 380 metres long, expired in September.
Kružni tok i četiri trake pored tržnog centra već su asfaltirani i imaju pješačke prelaze.
The roundabout and the four lanes next to the shopping centre are already asphalted and have pedestrian crossings.
Završen je i most preko rijeke Dobrinje.
The bridge over the Dobrinja river is also finished.
Ipak, ostatak prostora oko ceste je i dalje gradilište.
However, the rest of the area around the road is still a construction site.
Ugovor vrijedan 6,41 milion KM potpisan je u oktobru 2025. s firmama Euro-Asfalt i Demus.
The contract worth 6.41 million KM was signed in October 2025 with the companies Euro-Asfalt and Demus.
Radovi su počeli 2. decembra 2025. i trebali su trajati devet mjeseci.
The works began on 2 December 2025 and were supposed to last nine months.
U aprilu je predstavnik izvođača rekao da će rok biti malo duži zbog snijega.
In April a representative of the contractor said the deadline would be a little longer because of snow.
Novi datum završetka još nije objavljen.
A new completion date has not been announced yet.
Kanton Sarajevo planira da cijela cesta od Stupa do aerodroma ima četiri trake do 2028. godine.
Sarajevo Canton plans for the whole road from Stup to the airport to have four lanes by 2028.

title: Muškarac priznao napad na župnika kod Brčkog, ide u pritvor
Man confessed to attack on parish priest near Brčko, goes into custody
body: Goran Hubijar (52) priznao je da je napao katoličkog svećenika Don Filipa Maršića kod Brčkog.
Goran Hubijar (52) confessed that he attacked Catholic priest Don Filip Maršić near Brčko.
Osnovni sud Brčko distrikta odredio mu je jednomjesečni pritvor, kako je predložilo tužilaštvo.
The Basic Court of Brčko District ordered one month of custody for him, as the prosecution proposed.
Sumnjiči se za teži oblik razbojništva, odnosno krađe uz upotrebu sile.
He is suspected of a more serious form of robbery, that is theft with the use of force.
Napad se dogodio 17. novembra navečer, kod katoličke crkve i župne kuće u Boću.
The attack happened on the evening of 17 November, near the Catholic church and parish house in Boće.
Napadač je imao masku i tražio je novac, a zatim je svećenika teško povrijedio nožem.
The attacker wore a mask and demanded money, and then seriously injured the priest with a knife.
Svećenik je liječen u Zdravstvenom centru Brčko.
The priest was treated at the Brčko Health Centre.
Policija je Hubijara pronašla i uhapsila za manje od 48 sati.
The police found and arrested Hubijar in less than 48 hours.
Hubijar je napad priznao kod policije, u prisustvu svog advokata.
Hubijar confessed to the attack at the police, in the presence of his lawyer.
U prostorijama koje je koristio pronađeni su predmeti i odjeća koji su povezani s napadom.
In the rooms he used, items and clothes connected to the attack were found.
Sud je rekao da postoji opasnost da pobjegne ili da ponovi djelo.
The court said there is a danger that he might flee or repeat the offence.
Tužilaštvo i policija nastavit će istragu.
The prosecution and police will continue the investigation.

title: Ripač na Uni čuva ostatke drevnih kuća na vodi
Ripač on the Una preserves the remains of ancient houses on water
body: Ripač je mjesto na rijeci Uni, nekoliko kilometara jugoistočno od Bihaća.
Ripač is a place on the Una river, a few kilometres southeast of Bihać.
Ljudi tu žive bez prekida već nekoliko hiljada godina.
People have lived there without a break for several thousand years.
Na lokalitetu Gradina nalaze se ostaci prahistorijskog naselja sojenica, jednog od najpoznatijih u BiH.
At the Gradina site there are remains of a prehistoric settlement of pile dwellings, one of the best known in BiH.
Sojenice su kuće koje su građene iznad vode, na drvenim stubovima.
Pile dwellings are houses that were built above water, on wooden posts.
Arheolozi su u koritu Une pronašli više od 2.500 hrastovih stubova.
Archaeologists found more than 2,500 oak posts in the bed of the Una.
Kuće su bile velike oko 12 puta 6 metara.
The houses were about 12 by 6 metres in size.
Naselje je povezano s Japodima, ilirskim narodom koji je živio u zapadnoj Bosni.
The settlement is connected to the Japodes, an Illyrian people who lived in western Bosnia.
Neki predmeti, kao figure od gline, čuvaju se u muzejima u Sarajevu i Bihaću.
Some objects, such as clay figures, are kept in museums in Sarajevo and Bihać.
Nijaz Lipovača iz Bihaća smatra da bi ovo naslijeđe trebalo bolje predstaviti turistima.
Nijaz Lipovača from Bihać believes that this heritage should be better presented to tourists.
Predlaže da se sojenice obnove, kako bi posjetioci vidjeli kako su ljudi nekada živjeli.
He proposes that the pile dwellings be rebuilt, so visitors could see how people once lived.
Za to su ipak prvo potrebna stručna istraživanja i saradnja institucija, arheologa i Grada Bihaća.
For that, however, expert research and cooperation of institutions, archaeologists and the City of Bihać are needed first.

title: Mehmedović kritikovao Dodika i stranke iz Sarajeva
Mehmedović criticised Dodik and the parties from Sarajevo
body: Poslanik u Predstavničkom domu Parlamentarne skupštine BiH Šemsudin Mehmedović reagovao je u subotu na izjave Milorada Dodika.
Member of the House of Representatives of the Parliamentary Assembly of BiH Šemsudin Mehmedović reacted on Saturday to statements by Milorad Dodik.
Dodik je odbacio odluke Ustavnog suda BiH nakon što je sud odlučio o zastavama Armije RBiH.
Dodik rejected decisions of the Constitutional Court of BiH after the court ruled on the flags of the Army of RBiH.
Mehmedović kaže da je to direktan napad na ustavni poredak, mir i državu.
Mehmedović says that this is a direct attack on the constitutional order, peace and the state.
Prema njegovim riječima, Dodik otvoreno napada sud i najavljuje kraj Dejtonskog sporazuma.
According to him, Dodik openly attacks the court and announces the end of the Dayton Agreement.
Razlog je odluka suda da se ukine zabrana simbola Armije RBiH.
The reason is the court's decision to lift the ban on symbols of the Army of RBiH.
Mehmedović je kritikovao i stranke iz Sarajeva.
Mehmedović also criticised the parties from Sarajevo.
Rekao je da one godinama ne žele vidjeti šta Dodik planira, jer su im važnije ministarske fotelje.
He said that for years they have not wanted to see what Dodik is planning, because ministerial posts are more important to them.
On misli da će mnogi i sada šutjeti, jer žele s Dodikom dogovarati podjelu funkcija.
He thinks that many will stay silent now too, because they want to agree with Dodik on dividing posts.
Mehmedović je rekao da je Ustavni sud posljednja linija odbrane ustavnog poretka i mira.
Mehmedović said that the Constitutional Court is the last line of defence of the constitutional order and peace.
Upozorio je da oni koji sada šute kasnije neće imati šta braniti.
He warned that those who stay silent now will later have nothing to defend.

title: Minić: Nema razgovora o vlasti u BiH dok se ne riješe tri pitanja
Minić: No talks on government in BiH until three issues are resolved
body: Predsjednik Republike Srpske Savo Minić rekao je u subotu da na nivou BiH više neće biti razgovora.
Republika Srpska President Savo Minić said on Saturday that there will be no more talks at the level of BiH.
Prema njegovim riječima, RS neće pregovarati o formiranju vlasti i institucija dok se ne riješe tri pitanja.
According to him, RS will not negotiate on forming the government and institutions until three issues are resolved.
To su državna imovina, Ustavni sud BiH i Ured visokog predstavnika, odnosno OHR.
These are state property, the Constitutional Court of BiH and the Office of the High Representative, that is the OHR.
Minić je ljut zbog dvije nove odluke Ustavnog suda BiH.
Minić is angry about two new decisions of the Constitutional Court of BiH.
Sud je odlučio da zabrana simbola Armije RBiH u RS-u nije u skladu s Ustavom.
The court decided that the ban on symbols of the Army of RBiH in RS is not in line with the Constitution.
Također je poništio veto Željke Cvijanović na odluku Predsjedništva od 29. juna.
It also annulled Željka Cvijanović's veto on a Presidency decision of 29 June.
Tom odlukom imenovana su 4 člana Komisije za očuvanje nacionalnih spomenika, a ona i dalje važi.
That decision appointed 4 members of the Commission for the Preservation of National Monuments, and it remains in force.
Minić je rekao da je RS pokazala svoj politički i institucionalni kapacitet.
Minić said that RS has shown its political and institutional capacity.
Dodao je da je Dejtonski sporazum obavezan, ali da je, prema njegovom mišljenju, potpuno oslabljen.
He added that the Dayton Agreement is binding, but that, in his opinion, it has been completely weakened.
Sada je za RS najvažnije da brani svoje entitetske institucije, rekao je Minić.
Now the most important thing for RS is to defend its entity institutions, Minić said.
Upozorio je da bi RS mogla imati ozbiljne probleme ako ne zaštiti imovinu i svoje nadležnosti.
He warned that RS could have serious problems if it does not protect property and its powers.

title: Suljagić oštro kritikovao sud u Hagu nakon presude Mijanmaru
Suljagić sharply criticised the court in The Hague after the Myanmar verdict
body: Direktor Memorijalnog centra Srebrenica Emir Suljagić kritikovao je u subotu Međunarodni sud pravde u Hagu.
The director of the Srebrenica Memorial Center Emir Suljagić criticised the International Court of Justice in The Hague on Saturday.
Reagovao je na presudu od 19. novembra, kada je sud utvrdio da je Mijanmar počinio genocid nad Rohingyama.
He reacted to the verdict of 19 November, when the court found that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya.
Prema pisanju medija, to je prvi put da je sud jednu državu proglasio odgovornom za genocid.
According to media reports, it is the first time the court has declared a state responsible for genocide.
Tužbu je podnijela Gambija, a sudije su odlučile sa 9 glasova za i 6 protiv.
The case was filed by Gambia, and the judges decided with 9 votes for and 6 against.
Suljagić je napisao da sud ne bi presudio u korist BiH protiv Srbije ni da su ubijeni svi Bošnjaci.
Suljagić wrote that the court would not have ruled in favour of BiH against Serbia even if all Bosniaks had been killed.
Smatra da je genocid, prema tom sudu, rezervisan za narode u Aziji i Africi.
He believes that genocide, according to that court, is reserved for peoples in Asia and Africa.
Dodao je da je Srebrenica priznata kao genocid samo zato što je dokaza bilo jako mnogo.
He added that Srebrenica was recognised as genocide only because there was a great deal of evidence.
BiH je tužbu protiv Srbije podnijela 1993. godine.
BiH filed the lawsuit against Serbia in 1993.
Sud je 2007. godine presudio da je u Srebrenici u julu 1995. počinjen genocid nad Bošnjacima.
In 2007 the court ruled that genocide against Bosniaks was committed in Srebrenica in July 1995.
Ipak, Srbija nije proglašena odgovornom, ali sud je rekao da nije spriječila genocid i kaznila počinioce.
However, Serbia was not declared responsible, but the court said it did not prevent the genocide and punish the perpetrators.

title: Djeca kao vodiči u Muzeju Sarajeva prvi put u BiH
Children as guides at the Museum of Sarajevo for the first time in BiH
body: Povodom Svjetskog dana djece, Muzej Sarajeva pokrenuo je program „Djeca preuzimaju muzej“.
On the occasion of World Children's Day, the Museum of Sarajevo launched the programme "Children take over the museum".
Djeca od 10 do 13 godina posjetiocima predstavljaju stalne postavke muzeja na tri lokacije.
Children aged 10 to 13 present the museum's permanent exhibitions to visitors at three locations.
Iz muzeja kažu da se ovakav program u BiH održava prvi put.
The museum says that a programme like this is being held in BiH for the first time.
Mališani rade kao vodiči, edukatori i saradnici za odnose s javnošću, uz pomoć muzejskog tima.
The children work as guides, educators and public relations associates, with the help of the museum team.
Mogu se posjetiti Brusa bezistan, Despića kuća i Muzej Sarajevo 1878–1918.
Brusa bezistan, the Despić house and the Museum Sarajevo 1878–1918 can be visited.
Bilo je 20 mjesta, a djeca su podijeljena u dvije grupe po 10.
There were 20 places, and the children were divided into two groups of 10.
Program je besplatan za posjetioce.
The programme is free for visitors.
Od 9. do 13. novembra djeca su imala kratak „razgovor za posao“ i upoznala tim muzeja.
From 9 to 13 November the children had a short "job interview" and met the museum team.
Sedmicu prije programa mogla su gledati kako zaposleni rade s posjetiocima.
The week before the programme they could watch how staff work with visitors.
Muzej kaže da posjetioci tako mogu vidjeti postavke očima mlađih generacija.
The museum says that visitors can thus see the exhibitions through the eyes of younger generations.

title: Građani u Rijasetu čestitali novom reisul-ulemi Grabusu
Citizens at the Rijaset congratulated the new Reis-ul-ulema Grabus
body: Mnogi građani došli su u subotu u zgradu Rijaseta Islamske zajednice na Kovačima u Sarajevu.
Many citizens came on Saturday to the Rijaset building of the Islamic Community at Kovači in Sarajevo.
Tamo su čestitali Nedžadu Grabusu, koji je nedavno postao reisul-ulema Islamske zajednice u BiH.
There they congratulated Nedžad Grabus, who recently became Reis-ul-ulema of the Islamic Community in BiH.
Reisul-ulema je vjerski poglavar muslimana u Bosni i Hercegovini.
The Reis-ul-ulema is the religious head of Muslims in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Posjetioci su se rukovali s Grabusom, razgovarali s njim i fotografisali se.
Visitors shook hands with Grabus, talked with him and had their photos taken.
Grabus je izabran 10. oktobra, a njegov mandat traje do 2033. godine.
Grabus was elected on 10 October, and his term lasts until 2033.
Dužnost je zvanično preuzeo 15. novembra u Gazi Husrev-begovoj džamiji, kada je dobio menšuru.
He officially took office on 15 November in the Gazi Husrev-beg Mosque, when he received the menšura.
Menšura je službeni dokument o imenovanju.
The menšura is the official document of appointment.
Na tom mjestu Grabus je naslijedio Husein-ef. Kavazovića.
In that position Grabus succeeded Husein-ef. Kavazović.
Iz Rijaseta su rekli da se Grabus zahvalio svima koji su mu poslali čestitke nakon izbora.
The Rijaset said that Grabus thanked everyone who sent him congratulations after the election.
Zbog mnogo obaveza nije mogao odgovoriti na svaku poruku, ali cijeni pažnju i lijepe želje.
Because of many obligations he could not answer every message, but he appreciates the attention and kind wishes.

title: Jogurt bi mogao pomoći u zaštiti od raka crijeva
Yogurt could help protect against bowel cancer
body: Ljekari upozoravaju da sve više ljudi mlađih od 55 godina dobija rak debelog crijeva.
Doctors warn that more and more people younger than 55 are getting colon cancer.
Kao važan uzrok navode ishranu, posebno veliku količinu prerađene hrane.
As an important cause they name diet, especially a large amount of processed food.
Britanski onkolog Justin Stebbing piše da bi redovno jedenje jogurta moglo pomoći.
British oncologist Justin Stebbing writes that eating yogurt regularly could help.
Onkolog je ljekar koji liječi rak, a Stebbing radi i kao profesor na univerzitetu Anglia Ruskin.
An oncologist is a doctor who treats cancer, and Stebbing also works as a professor at Anglia Ruskin University.
Prema njegovom tekstu, jogurt mijenja bakterije koje žive u našim crijevima.
According to his text, yogurt changes the bacteria that live in our intestines.
Dobar balans tih bakterija važan je za imunitet i može spriječiti upale.
A good balance of these bacteria is important for immunity and can prevent inflammation.
Jogurt sadrži žive kulture korisnih bakterija koje pomažu da taj balans ostane zdrav.
Yogurt contains live cultures of useful bacteria that help that balance stay healthy.
Stebbing kaže da bi jogurt mogao štititi od nekih agresivnih oblika ove bolesti.
Stebbing says that yogurt could protect against some aggressive forms of this disease.
Ipak, u tekstu nema brojeva ni detalja o konkretnom istraživanju.
However, the text has no numbers or details about a specific study.
Ljekari podsjećaju da rizik povećavaju i pušenje, alkohol, prerađeno meso i premalo kretanja.
Doctors remind us that smoking, alcohol, processed meat and too little exercise also increase the risk.

title: Reuters: Epstein je godinama tražio veze u Rusiji
Reuters: Epstein spent years looking for connections in Russia
body: Agencija Reuters objavila je veliko istraživanje o vezama Jeffreyja Epsteina s Rusijom.
The Reuters agency published a large investigation about Jeffrey Epstein's ties with Russia.
Novinari su razgovarali s više od 20 ljudi i pregledali stotine stranica dokumenata, letova i e-mailova.
The journalists talked to more than 20 people and reviewed hundreds of pages of documents, flights and emails.
Prema istraživanju, Rusija je bila jedno od glavnih mjesta gdje je Epstein tražio mlade žene.
According to the investigation, Russia was one of the main places where Epstein looked for young women.
Reuters je pronašao najmanje 17 žena iz bivšeg Sovjetskog Saveza koje su bile žrtve njegove mreže.
Reuters found at least 17 women from the former Soviet Union who were victims of his network.
Važnu ulogu imao je francuski agent za modele Jean-Luc Brunel, koji je tražio manekenke u istočnoj Evropi.
An important role was played by the French model agent Jean-Luc Brunel, who looked for models in Eastern Europe.
Epstein je Rusiju posjetio samo dva puta, 1998. i 2002. godine.
Epstein visited Russia only twice, in 1998 and 2002.
Nakon što je 2008. godine bio osuđen na Floridi, pokušavao je preko Rusije ponovo doći do bogatih i moćnih ljudi.
After he was convicted in Florida in 2008, he tried to reach rich and powerful people again through Russia.
Epstein je dugo želio sresti ruskog predsjednika Vladimira Putina.
Epstein wanted to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin for a long time.
Jedno putovanje u Rusiju 2011. godine je otkazano, a ljudi koji su ga poznavali kažu da se sastanak nikada nije dogovorio.
One trip to Russia in 2011 was cancelled, and people who knew him say that the meeting was never arranged.
Reuters nije našao dokaze da je Epstein radio za rusku obavještajnu službu ili sreo Putina.
Reuters found no evidence that Epstein worked for the Russian intelligence service or met Putin.
Neke žene iz Rusije i danas traže pravdu.
Some women from Russia are still seeking justice today.

title: Harry Kane teško povrijeđen, neće igrati tri mjeseca
Harry Kane badly injured, will not play for three months
body: Napadač Bayerna Harry Kane povrijedio je ligament u lijevom skočnom zglobu.
Bayern striker Harry Kane injured a ligament in his left ankle.
Povreda se dogodila na utakmici protiv Kölna, koja je završila 1:1.
The injury happened in the match against Köln, which ended 1-1.
Sportski direktor Max Eberl kaže da Kane neće igrati oko tri mjeseca.
Sporting director Max Eberl says that Kane will not play for about three months.
Kane se povrijedio u 20. minuti na Allianz Areni, kada se sudario s defanzivcem Kölna Joelom Schmiedom.
Kane got injured in the 20th minute at the Allianz Arena, when he collided with Köln defender Joel Schmied.
Obojica su tada išla na loptu.
They were both going for the ball at the time.
Trener Vincent Kompany potvrdio je da će pauza biti duga, jer takve povrede obično traju tri do četiri mjeseca.
Coach Vincent Kompany confirmed that the break will be long, because such injuries usually last three to four months.
Kane će propustiti četiri utakmice Bayerna u Ligi prvaka i ostatak ove godine.
Kane will miss four Bayern matches in the Champions League and the rest of this year.
Povreda je došla samo nekoliko dana nakon što je Kane postigao gol za Englesku u pobjedi 3:2 protiv Španije.
The injury came only a few days after Kane scored a goal for England in a 3-2 win against Spain.
Ove godine osvojio je i Zlatnu loptu.
This year he also won the Ballon d'Or.
Utakmicu je napustio i Michael Olise, ali njegova povreda je lakša.
Michael Olise also left the match, but his injury is lighter.
Kompany se nada da će se Olise do ponedjeljka osjećati bolje.
Kompany hopes that Olise will feel better by Monday.

title: Jokić u drugom poluvremenu donio pobjedu Denveru
Jokić brought Denver the win in the second half
body: Denver Nuggets pobijedili su Houston Rocketse rezultatom 133:124 u NBA Kupu.
The Denver Nuggets beat the Houston Rockets 133-124 in the NBA Cup.
Nikola Jokić je u prvom poluvremenu postigao samo 2 poena.
Nikola Jokić scored only 2 points in the first half.
U drugom poluvremenu ubacio je još 24 poena i imao 11 asistencija.
In the second half he scored another 24 points and had 11 assists.
Houston je nakon tri četvrtine vodio 102:99, ali je Denver bio mnogo bolji na kraju.
Houston led 102-99 after three quarters, but Denver was much better at the end.
Vodstvo se mijenjalo čak 32 puta, što je najviše u ovoj NBA sezoni.
The lead changed as many as 32 times, which is the most in this NBA season.
Za Houston je Alperen Šengun imao 28 poena, 11 skokova i 10 asistencija nakon povratka s povrede oka.
For Houston, Alperen Šengun had 28 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists after returning from an eye injury.
Denver sada ima dvije pobjede u svojoj grupi.
Denver now has two wins in its group.
Luka Dončić predvodio je Los Angeles Lakerse u pobjedi 106:104 protiv Sacramenta.
Luka Dončić led the Los Angeles Lakers in a 106-104 win against Sacramento.
Dončić je imao 25 poena, a odlučujuću trojku 57 sekundi prije kraja ubacio je Quentin Grimes.
Dončić had 25 points, and Quentin Grimes hit the deciding three-pointer 57 seconds before the end.
Lakersi su pobijedili na 10 od posljednjih 11 utakmica.
The Lakers have won 10 of their last 11 games.
Iste noći James Harden je ubacio 51 poen za Cleveland i prestigao Kobea Bryanta na listi najboljih strijelaca.
The same night James Harden scored 51 points for Cleveland and passed Kobe Bryant on the list of top scorers.

title: Opozicija u RS-u protiv odluke Ustavnog suda o simbolima
Opposition in RS against the Constitutional Court decision on symbols
body: Ustavni sud BiH odlučio je 20. novembra da jedna odredba zakona Republike Srpske nije u skladu s Ustavom.
On 20 November the Constitutional Court of BiH decided that one provision of a Republika Srpska law is not in line with the Constitution.
Ta odredba je zabranjivala javno pokazivanje zastava, grbova i simbola Armije RBiH.
That provision banned the public display of flags, coats of arms and symbols of the Army of RBiH.
Prema zakonu RS-a, to je bilo krivično djelo, odnosno zločin za koji se može kazniti.
According to the RS law, this was a criminal offence, that is, a crime that can be punished.
Sud je rekao da odredba nije u skladu sa zakonima o simbolima Oružanih snaga BiH.
The court said that the provision is not in line with the laws on the symbols of the Armed Forces of BiH.
Opozicione stranke u RS-u odmah su kritikovale ovu odluku.
Opposition parties in RS immediately criticised this decision.
Lider PSS-a Draško Stanivuković rekao je da je odluka neprihvatljiva i da je to provokacija pred godišnjicu Dejtonskog sporazuma.
PSS leader Draško Stanivuković said that the decision is unacceptable and that it is a provocation before the anniversary of the Dayton Agreement.
Prema njegovim riječima, sada će se ta zastava moći pokazivati svuda u RS-u, na svadbama i na autima.
According to him, that flag will now be able to be displayed everywhere in RS, at weddings and on cars.
Ognjen Bodiroga iz SDS-a rekao je da sud ima različita pravila za RS.
Ognjen Bodiroga from the SDS said that the court has different rules for RS.
Kao primjer je naveo da je sud ranije zabranio himnu RS-a.
As an example, he said that the court had earlier banned the anthem of RS.
Bodiroga predlaže novi zakon o Ustavnom sudu.
Bodiroga proposes a new law on the Constitutional Court.
Prema tom prijedlogu, tri strana sudije trebale bi zamijeniti domaće sudije.
According to that proposal, domestic judges should replace the three foreign judges.

title: Natali Dizdar nakon više od 10 godina pjevala u Sarajevu
Natali Dizdar sang in Sarajevo after more than 10 years
body: Hrvatska pjevačica Natali Dizdar održala je koncert u sarajevskom Domu mladih.
Croatian singer Natali Dizdar held a concert in Sarajevo's Dom mladih.
Bio je to njen prvi samostalni koncert u Sarajevu nakon više od 10 godina.
It was her first solo concert in Sarajevo in more than 10 years.
Publika je uživala, a atmosfera je bila posebna.
The audience enjoyed it, and the atmosphere was special.
Na koncertu je pjevala stare hitove kao što su "Ne daj", "Stranac" i "Mjesto za jedno".
At the concert she sang old hits such as "Ne daj", "Stranac" and "Mjesto za jedno".
Izvela je i nove pjesme "Ocean", "Magija" i "Zadnji dan ljeta".
She also performed the new songs "Ocean", "Magija" and "Zadnji dan ljeta".
Album "Zadnji dan ljeta" snimila je s članovima grupe Porto Morto.
She recorded the album "Zadnji dan ljeta" with members of the band Porto Morto.
Dvije godine zaredom osvojila je nagradu Porin za najbolju žensku vokalnu izvedbu.
Two years in a row she won the Porin award for the best female vocal performance.
Prije koncerta pjevačica je rekla da ni sama ne zna zašto se nije vratila ranije.
Before the concert the singer said that she herself does not know why she did not come back earlier.
Dodala je da se sjeća topline i iskrenosti sarajevske publike.
She added that she remembers the warmth and openness of the Sarajevo audience.
Nekoliko njenih pjesama napisao je sarajevski muzičar Dino Šaran, ali on nije mogao doći na koncert.
Several of her songs were written by Sarajevo musician Dino Šaran, but he could not come to the concert.
U Sarajevo je došla nakon uspješne godine i rasprodanih koncerata u Zagrebu i Splitu.
She came to Sarajevo after a successful year and sold-out concerts in Zagreb and Split.

title: Ispod leda na Antarktiku otkrivene drevne velike planine
Ancient huge mountains discovered under the ice of Antarctica
body: Međunarodni tim naučnika otkrio je ostatke drevnih planinskih lanaca ispod leda na Antarktiku.
An international team of scientists has discovered the remains of ancient mountain ranges under the ice of Antarctica.
Te "superplanine" bile su velike kao današnje Himalaje.
These "super-mountains" were as big as today's Himalayas.
Istraživanje su uradili naučnici iz Australije i Njemačke, a rezultate je objavio jedan naučni časopis.
The research was done by scientists from Australia and Germany, and the results were published by a scientific journal.
Planine su nastale prije 650 do 450 miliona godina, kada se Antarktik sudario s Indijom i Afrikom.
The mountains formed 650 to 450 million years ago, when Antarctica collided with India and Africa.
Više od 99,5 posto Antarktika pokriva debeo led, pa naučnici nisu mogli direktno vidjeti stijene.
More than 99.5 percent of Antarctica is covered by thick ice, so the scientists could not see the rocks directly.
Zato su proučavali pijesak i mulj izvađen s dna okeana uz obalu kontinenta.
That is why they studied sand and mud taken from the ocean floor along the coast of the continent.
Analizirali su 1.712 malih kristala, koji čuvaju podatke o starosti stijena.
They analysed 1,712 small crystals, which keep information about the age of the rocks.
Profesor Ian Campbell smatra da su ove planine bile važne za razvoj života na Zemlji.
Professor Ian Campbell believes that these mountains were important for the development of life on Earth.
Kada su se brzo trošile, u okeane je stizalo mnogo hranjivih tvari, a u zraku je bilo više kisika.
When they were quickly wearing away, a lot of nutrients reached the oceans, and there was more oxygen in the air.
To je možda pomoglo da se prije oko 539 miliona godina pojave prve životinje s tvrdim kosturom.
That may have helped the first animals with a hard skeleton to appear about 539 million years ago.

title: Elvir Bolić: Danska je najteži protivnik za BiH
Elvir Bolić: Denmark is the toughest opponent for BiH
body: Reprezentacija Bosne i Hercegovine igrat će protiv Danske u baražu Lige nacija.
The national team of Bosnia and Herzegovina will play against Denmark in the Nations League play-off.
Pobjednik ovog dvomeča ulazi u Ligu A, najjaču grupu takmičenja.
The winner of this two-legged tie goes into League A, the strongest group of the competition.
Bivši napadač Elvir Bolić rekao je za Klix.ba da je Danska vjerovatno najteži protivnik kojeg je BiH mogla dobiti.
Former striker Elvir Bolić told Klix.ba that Denmark is probably the toughest opponent BiH could have drawn.
BiH je mogla igrati i protiv Hrvatske, Srbije ili Walesa.
BiH could also have played against Croatia, Serbia or Wales.
Prva utakmica bit će u BiH 25. marta 2027. godine, a revanš tri dana kasnije u Danskoj.
The first match will be in BiH on 25 March 2027, and the return match three days later in Denmark.
Bolić kaže da nije želio igrati protiv komšija, iako BiH protiv njih često ima dobre rezultate.
Bolić says he did not want to play against the neighbours, although BiH often has good results against them.
Prema njegovom mišljenju, Danska je na nivou Švedske, a BiH je nedavno dobro igrala protiv Švedske.
In his opinion, Denmark is at the level of Sweden, and BiH recently played well against Sweden.
Bolić je rekao da je ovo najbolja godina u historiji reprezentacije.
Bolić said that this is the best year in the history of the national team.
Prije dvije godine niko nije očekivao takve rezultate.
Two years ago nobody expected such results.
On hvali trenera i stručni štab jer su pronašli nekoliko mladih igrača i dali im priliku da rano igraju.
He praises the coach and the staff because they found several young players and gave them a chance to play early.
Danas igrači imaju odlične uslove, dok je njegova generacija prije 20 godina radila skoro kao amateri.
Today the players have excellent conditions, while his generation 20 years ago worked almost like amateurs.

title: Putin dao intervju Emiru Kusturici za dokumentarni film
Putin gave an interview to Emir Kusturica for a documentary film
body: Ruski predsjednik Vladimir Putin dao je intervju reditelju Emiru Kusturici, koji je rođen u Sarajevu.
Russian President Vladimir Putin gave an interview to director Emir Kusturica, who was born in Sarajevo.
Intervju je dio dokumentarnog filma za ruski Prvi kanal.
The interview is part of a documentary film for Russia's Channel One.
Film je napravljen za 80. rođendan patrijarha Kirila, poglavara Ruske pravoslavne crkve.
The film was made for the 80th birthday of Patriarch Kirill, the head of the Russian Orthodox Church.
Putin je govorio o Ukrajini i rekao da ukrajinski vojnici trebaju preći na rusku stranu.
Putin spoke about Ukraine and said that Ukrainian soldiers should cross over to the Russian side.
Tvrdio je da Ukrajina danas ima oko 20 miliona stanovnika, a 1986. godine imala je više od 50 miliona.
He claimed that Ukraine today has about 20 million inhabitants, while in 1986 it had more than 50 million.
Ispričao je i da ga je majka tajno krstila, a da otac nije znao.
He also said that his mother had him baptised in secret, without his father knowing.
Kasnije je saznao da je otac patrijarha Kirila bio svećenik u toj crkvi.
Later he found out that Patriarch Kirill's father was a priest in that church.
Na pitanje da li je Rusija barka koja spašava vjernike, Putin je odgovorio da jeste.
Asked whether Russia is an ark that saves believers, Putin answered that it is.
Rekao je da je Moskva treći Rim i da četvrtog neće biti.
He said that Moscow is the third Rome and that there will be no fourth.
Prema njegovim riječima, u Rusiji postoje četiri tradicionalne religije: pravoslavlje, islam, judaizam i budizam.
According to him, there are four traditional religions in Russia: Orthodoxy, Islam, Judaism and Buddhism.
Cijeli intervju objavljen je na web-stranici Kremlja.
The whole interview was published on the Kremlin website.

title: Financial Times: Poslovi Trumpovih ljudi prijete miru u BiH
Financial Times: Business deals of Trump's people threaten peace in BiH
body: Britanski list Financial Times objavio je tekst o novoj politici SAD-a prema Bosni i Hercegovini.
The British newspaper Financial Times has published an article about the new US policy towards Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Prema listu, Washington sada više brine o poslovima ljudi bliskih Donaldu Trumpu nego o miru i stabilnosti.
According to the paper, Washington now cares more about the business of people close to Donald Trump than about peace and stability.
SAD su prije 30 godina Dejtonskim sporazumom zaustavile rat u BiH i dugo su branile taj sistem.
Thirty years ago the US stopped the war in BiH with the Dayton Agreement, and it defended that system for a long time.
U centru priče je kompanija AAFS, koju vode bivši Trumpov advokat Jesse Binnall i Joseph Flynn.
At the centre of the story is the company AAFS, which is run by Trump's former lawyer Jesse Binnall and Joseph Flynn.
Bijela kuća podržava AAFS kao investitora u Južnu interkonekciju, gasovod koji bi BiH povezao s Hrvatskom.
The White House supports AAFS as the investor in the Southern Interconnection, a gas pipeline that would connect BiH with Croatia.
Parlament FBiH je u aprilu promijenio zakon, pa je AAFS postao glavni investitor bez javnog tendera.
In April the FBiH Parliament changed the law, so AAFS became the main investor without a public tender.
Organizacija Transparency International rekla je da je to opasan presedan.
The organisation Transparency International said that this is a dangerous precedent.
Binnall tvrdi da im veze s Trumpom nisu otvorile vrata.
Binnall claims that their connections with Trump did not open doors for them.
List piše i da je visoki predstavnik Christian Schmidt najavio ostavku nakon jakog pritiska Trumpove administracije.
The paper also writes that High Representative Christian Schmidt announced his resignation after strong pressure from the Trump administration.
Bivši ambasador SAD-a u BiH Michael Murphy rekao je da Washington želi visokog predstavnika kojeg može kontrolisati.
The former US ambassador to BiH, Michael Murphy, said that Washington wants a high representative it can control.
Senatorica Jeanne Shaheen upozorila je da takva politika može dovesti do novog sukoba.
Senator Jeanne Shaheen warned that such a policy could lead to a new conflict.

title: Trump zatvorio oči dok je Xi govorio na samitu u Kini
Trump closed his eyes while Xi spoke at the summit in China
body: Američki predsjednik Donald Trump sjedio je oko 10 sekundi zatvorenih očiju na samitu APEC-a u Kini.
US President Donald Trump sat with his eyes closed for about 10 seconds at the APEC summit in China.
To se desilo u četvrtak u gradu Shenzhenu, dok je kineski predsjednik Xi Jinping držao govor.
This happened on Thursday in the city of Shenzhen, while Chinese President Xi Jinping was giving a speech.
Xi je govorio o slobodnoj trgovini i ekonomskoj saradnji u regiji.
Xi spoke about free trade and economic cooperation in the region.
Snimak je napravila kineska državna televizija CCTV, a brzo se proširio društvenim mrežama.
The footage was made by Chinese state television CCTV, and it quickly spread on social media.
Kritičari tvrde da je Trump zaspao i to nazivaju sramotom.
Critics claim that Trump fell asleep and call it a disgrace.
Slični snimci kruže od 2025. godine, i to sa sastanaka u Bijeloj kući.
Similar videos have been circulating since 2025, including from meetings in the White House.
Direktor za komunikacije Bijele kuće Steven Cheung rekao je da su to lažne vijesti.
The White House communications director Steven Cheung said that this is fake news.
Prema njegovim riječima, Trump je gledao papire ispred sebe.
According to him, Trump was looking at the papers in front of him.
Trump je u januaru rekao da samo trepće i da su mu sastanci opuštajući.
In January Trump said that he was only blinking and that he finds meetings relaxing.
Trump ima 80 godina i najstarija je osoba koja je postala predsjednik SAD-a.
Trump is 80 years old and is the oldest person to have become US president.

title: Maya Jama nagovijestila da želi biti nova Bondova djevojka
Maya Jama hints that she wants to be the new Bond girl
body: Britanska voditeljica Maya Jama objavila je na Instagramu fotografiju glumice Monice Bellucci.
British presenter Maya Jama posted a photo of actress Monica Bellucci on Instagram.
Nazvala ju je svojom muzom, a mnogi to vide kao znak da želi ulogu u novom filmu o Jamesu Bondu.
She called her her muse, and many see this as a sign that she wants a role in the new James Bond film.
Bellucci je 2015. godine glumila u Bond filmu "Spectre", uz Daniela Craiga.
In 2015 Bellucci acted in the Bond film "Spectre", alongside Daniel Craig.
Ovo je već druga objava za nekoliko dana koja podgrijava glasine.
This is already the second post in a few days that fuels the rumours.
Robert Pattinson je u ponedjeljak predstavljen kao novi James Bond.
On Monday Robert Pattinson was presented as the new James Bond.
Kladionica William Hill sada daje Jami bolje šanse za ulogu, 5 prema 1 umjesto 7 prema 1.
The bookmaker William Hill now gives Jama better odds for the role, 5 to 1 instead of 7 to 1.
Snimanje novog filma očekuje se tokom 2027. godine.
Filming of the new film is expected during 2027.
Jama je nedavno napustila emisiju "Love Island" nakon što je potpisala ugovor s Netflixom.
Jama recently left the show "Love Island" after she signed a contract with Netflix.
Kao kandidatkinje za ulogu spominju se i Sydney Sweeney, Kendall Jenner i Margaret Qualley.
Sydney Sweeney, Kendall Jenner and Margaret Qualley are also mentioned as candidates for the role.

title: Energetska pića mogu biti opasna za srce mladih ljudi
Energy drinks may be dangerous for young people's hearts
body: Nova analiza iz SAD-a pokazuje da energetska pića mogu biti opasnija za srce nego što se mislilo.
A new analysis from the US shows that energy drinks may be more dangerous for the heart than was thought.
Rezultati su predstavljeni ovog mjeseca na skupu Američkog udruženja za srce.
The results were presented this month at a meeting of the American Heart Association.
Istraživači su pregledali 28.345 prijava zdravstvenih problema iz perioda od 2017. do 2025. godine.
The researchers examined 28,345 reports of health problems from the period from 2017 to 2025.
Od toga, 854 prijave odnosile su se na proizvode s kofeinom ili drugim stimulansima.
Of these, 854 reports concerned products with caffeine or other stimulants.
Stimulansi su tvari koje ubrzavaju rad srca i tijela.
Stimulants are substances that speed up the work of the heart and the body.
Kod tih proizvoda srčani zastoj prijavljivan je oko 11 puta češće, a infarkt oko 4,5 puta češće.
With these products cardiac arrest was reported about 11 times more often, and heart attack about 4.5 times more often.
Oko 45 posto problema imale su mlade osobe od 18 do 34 godine.
About 45 percent of the problems were in young people aged 18 to 34.
Autori misle da mladi češće piju ova pića prije treninga ili ih miješaju s alkoholom.
The authors think that young people drink these drinks more often before training or mix them with alcohol.
Kardiolog Gregory Marcus rekao je da studija ne dokazuje direktnu vezu, ali da su potrebna nova istraživanja.
Cardiologist Gregory Marcus said that the study does not prove a direct link, but that new research is needed.
Za većinu zdravih odraslih osoba do 400 miligrama kofeina dnevno smatra se sigurnim.
For most healthy adults up to 400 milligrams of caffeine a day is considered safe.

title: Mirvić aktivirao mjenice od 500.000 KM, Željezničar se buni
Mirvić cashes in promissory notes worth 500,000 KM, Željezničar objects
body: Bivši investitor FK Željezničar Sanin Mirvić aktivirao je dvije mjenice vrijedne ukupno 500.000 KM.
Former FK Željezničar investor Sanin Mirvić has activated two promissory notes worth a total of 500,000 KM.
Mjenica je papir kojim se neko obavezuje da će platiti dug.
A promissory note is a paper by which someone promises to pay a debt.
Banka je klub o tome obavijestila 19. novembra, a klub kaže da njegov račun nije blokiran.
The bank informed the club about it on 19 November, and the club says that its account is not blocked.
Mirvić je u septembru tražio da mu klub vrati 923.181 KM.
In September Mirvić asked the club to return 923,181 KM to him.
Prema klubu, on je ove godine uplatio 524.000 KM, ali traži skoro 400.000 KM više.
According to the club, he paid 524,000 KM this year, but he is asking for almost 400,000 KM more.
Klub kaže da je taj novac išao drugim osobama i da o tim uplatama nije znao.
The club says that this money went to other people and that it did not know about those payments.
Sud je ranije zabranio naplatu mjenica, ali ta odluka više ne važi.
A court earlier banned collection on the notes, but that decision is no longer valid.
Predstavnici kluba sastali su se s Mirvićem 13. novembra.
Club representatives met with Mirvić on 13 November.
Ponudili su da mu vrate novac koji je uplatio na račun kluba, ali on je to odbio.
They offered to return the money he had paid into the club's account, but he refused.
Advokati bi trebali nastaviti razgovore početkom sljedeće sedmice.
The lawyers are expected to continue talks at the beginning of next week.
Mirvić je krajem juna podnio ostavku na mjesto predsjednika kluba.
At the end of June Mirvić resigned from the post of club president.

title: Vijeće ministara ukinulo odluku o kupovini zgrade u Istočnom Sarajevu
Council of Ministers cancels decision on buying a building in East Sarajevo
body: Vijeće ministara BiH ukinulo je svoju odluku o kupovini zgrade za državne institucije u Istočnom Sarajevu.
The Council of Ministers of BiH has cancelled its decision on buying a building for state institutions in East Sarajevo.
Nova odluka objavljena je danas u Službenom glasniku BiH.
The new decision was published today in the Official Gazette of BiH.
Vijeće ju je donijelo na sjednici 28. oktobra, a potpisala ju je predsjedavajuća Borjana Krišto.
The Council adopted it at a session on 28 October, and it was signed by the chair, Borjana Krišto.
Ipak, država nije odustala od kupovine zgrada.
However, the state has not given up on buying buildings.
Zgrade u Istočnom Sarajevu i Banjoj Luci sada će se kupiti kroz javnu nabavku.
The buildings in East Sarajevo and Banja Luka will now be bought through public procurement.
Javna nabavka je postupak u kojem država traži najbolju ponudu od više prodavača.
Public procurement is a procedure in which the state looks for the best offer from several sellers.
Rok za cijeli projekat pomjeren je do kraja 2027. godine.
The deadline for the whole project has been moved to the end of 2027.
Postupke će voditi Služba za zajedničke poslove institucija BiH.
The procedures will be run by the Joint Services of BiH Institutions.
Vijeće ministara je ovlastilo direktora te službe da potpiše ugovore o kupovini.
The Council of Ministers authorised the director of that service to sign the purchase contracts.
On će to moći uraditi kada postupci javne nabavke budu završeni.
He will be able to do that when the public procurement procedures are finished.

title: SDP podržao Nikšića nakon optužnice, traži istragu tužilaca
SDP backs Nikšić after indictment, asks for an investigation of prosecutors
body: Socijaldemokratska partija BiH dala je punu podršku svom predsjedniku Nerminu Nikšiću.
The Social Democratic Party of BiH has given full support to its president, Nermin Nikšić.
Tužilaštvo POSKOK danas je podiglo optužnicu protiv Nikšića, Rame Isaka, Vahidina Munjića i drugih.
The POSKOK prosecutor's office today filed an indictment against Nikšić, Ramo Isak, Vahidin Munjić and others.
Tužioci traže i da Nikšić i Isak ne mogu obavljati svoje funkcije.
The prosecutors also ask that Nikšić and Isak cannot perform their duties.
Nikšić je ranije danas rekao da nijedna riječ iz optužnice nije istinita.
Earlier today Nikšić said that not a single word of the indictment is true.
SDP kaže da podržava nezavisan rad pravosuđa, ali traži da sudija pažljivo pročita dokaze.
SDP says that it supports the independent work of the judiciary, but it asks the judge to read the evidence carefully.
Stranka je uvjerena da će optuženi dokazati da su nevini.
The party is convinced that the accused will prove that they are innocent.
Prema SDP-u, neki ljudi iz tužilaštva daju materijale medijima da bi utjecali na politiku.
According to SDP, some people from the prosecution give materials to the media in order to influence politics.
Zato SDP traži da VSTV istraži veze između tužilaca i medija.
That is why SDP asks the VSTV to investigate the links between prosecutors and the media.
VSTV je tijelo koje bira i kontroliše sudije i tužioce u BiH.
The VSTV is the body that appoints and supervises judges and prosecutors in BiH.
Stranka nije navela imena tužilaca ni medija i nije pokazala dokaze za svoje tvrdnje.
The party did not name the prosecutors or the media and did not show evidence for its claims.

title: BBC objavio reportažu o selu Lukomir na Bjelašnici
BBC publishes a report on the village of Lukomir on Bjelašnica
body: Britanski BBC objavio je putopis o Lukomiru, najvišem i najizoliranijem selu u Bosni i Hercegovini.
The British BBC has published a travel story about Lukomir, the highest and most isolated village in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Tekst je napisala američka novinarka Kristin Vuković, koja je u selo došla s prijateljima i vodičem.
The text was written by American journalist Kristin Vuković, who came to the village with friends and a guide.
Od Umoljana do Lukomira hodali su sedam kilometara, oko tri sata.
From Umoljani to Lukomir they walked seven kilometres, about three hours.
U selu ljudi žive od 1. maja do 1. novembra, a zimu provode u nižim mjestima, uglavnom u Hadžićima.
People live in the village from 1 May to 1 November, and they spend the winter in lower places, mostly in Hadžići.
Oni koji još imaju ovce vode ih pješice, a put traje oko 10 sati.
Those who still have sheep take them on foot, and the journey takes about 10 hours.
Struja je u selo stigla tek prije oko 60 godina i često nestaje.
Electricity arrived in the village only about 60 years ago, and it often goes out.
U Lukomiru danas živi 55 ljudi u 25 domaćinstava, a svake godine dođe 100.000 do 150.000 turista.
Today 55 people live in Lukomir in 25 households, and 100,000 to 150,000 tourists come every year.
Novinarka je spavala kod Saime i Omera Čomora, gdje noćenje košta 30 eura.
The journalist stayed with Saima and Omer Čomor, where a night costs 30 euros.
Saima ju je naučila praviti pitu sa sirom u peći na drva.
Saima taught her to make cheese pie in a wood-fired oven.
Saima je rekla da su turisti iz Amerike, Australije i Evrope za selo velika Božija milost.
Saima said that the tourists from America, Australia and Europe are a great blessing from God for the village.

title: Menadžment Dine Merlina odgovorio Splitu i najavio pravnike
Dino Merlin's management responds to Split and announces lawyers
body: Menadžment Dine Merlina oglasio se nakon što je Split otkazao njegov novogodišnji koncert.
Dino Merlin's management has spoken out after Split cancelled his New Year concert.
Merlin je trebao pjevati 30. decembra na splitskoj Rivi.
Merlin was supposed to sing on 30 December on Split's Riva.
Gradonačelnik Tomislav Šuta ranije je objavio da koncerta neće biti.
Mayor Tomislav Šuta announced earlier that there would be no concert.
Prema menadžmentu, dogovorena cijena bila je 140.000 eura bruto za pjevača, cijeli tim i promociju.
According to the management, the agreed price was 140,000 euros gross for the singer, the whole team and promotion.
Sponzori bi platili 80.000 eura, pa bi trošak za gradski budžet bio mnogo manji.
Sponsors would have paid 80,000 euros, so the cost for the city budget would have been much smaller.
Iznos od 160.000 eura, o kojem pišu mediji, odnosi se na tehniku za dva koncerta, a ne na Merlinov honorar.
The amount of 160,000 euros that the media write about refers to the technology for two concerts, not to Merlin's fee.
Menadžment kaže i da ugovor nikada nije bio potpisan.
The management also says that the contract was never signed.
Oni pitaju zašto je grad otkazao samo njegov nastup, dok ostali program ide dalje.
They ask why the city cancelled only his performance, while the rest of the programme goes ahead.
Menadžment tvrdi da je pjevač zbog ove odluke pretrpio veliku štetu za ugled.
The management claims that the singer suffered great damage to his reputation because of this decision.
Zato će dalju komunikaciju s gradom voditi međunarodni tim pravnih stručnjaka.
That is why further communication with the city will be handled by an international team of legal experts.

title: Barbarez nakon žrijeba: Protiv Danske idemo hrabro
Barbarez after the draw: We go boldly against Denmark
body: Selektor BiH Sergej Barbarez govorio je nakon žrijeba za baraž Lige nacija u Nyonu.
Bosnia and Herzegovina head coach Sergej Barbarez spoke after the draw for the Nations League play-off in Nyon.
Zmajevi će u martu igrati protiv Danske za mjesto u Ligi A.
In March the Dragons will play Denmark for a place in League A.
Barbarez je rekao da se njegovo mišljenje nije promijenilo nakon žrijeba.
Barbarez said that his opinion did not change after the draw.
BiH je u svojoj grupi Lige B završila na drugom mjestu i zato igra baraž.
Bosnia and Herzegovina finished second in its League B group, and that is why it plays the play-off.
Danska je u grupi Lige A bila treća i sada se bori da ostane u najjačoj ligi.
Denmark was third in its League A group and is now fighting to stay in the strongest league.
Prema danskim medijima, prva utakmica bit će u BiH između 25. i 27. marta.
According to Danish media, the first match will be in Bosnia and Herzegovina between 25 and 27 March.
Revanš se igra u Danskoj između 28. i 30. marta 2027. godine.
The return leg is played in Denmark between 28 and 30 March 2027.
Barbarez je rekao da tim ide u baraž sa samopouzdanjem i dobrim rezultatima.
Barbarez said that the team goes into the play-off with confidence and good results.
Dodao je da je privilegija igrati protiv najboljih reprezentacija.
He added that it is a privilege to play against the best national teams.
Tačni datumi i stadioni još nisu potvrđeni, ali se očekuju Bilino Polje i Parken.
The exact dates and stadiums have not yet been confirmed, but Bilino Polje and Parken are expected.

title: Dodik ismijao pravilo UIO-a o povratu PDV-a za kuće
Dodik mocks the ITA rule on VAT refunds for houses
body: Lider SNSD-a Milorad Dodik ismijao je stav Uprave za indirektno oporezivanje BiH.
SNSD leader Milorad Dodik mocked the position of the Indirect Taxation Authority of Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Uprava, ili UIO, kaže da građani koji grade kuću na svom zemljištu nemaju pravo na povrat PDV-a.
The authority, or UIO, says that citizens who build a house on their own land have no right to a VAT refund.
Dodik je na mreži X napisao da je to jedna od najglupljih stvari koje je nedavno čuo.
Dodik wrote on the X network that it is one of the most foolish things he has heard recently.
U video obraćanju je pitao na čijem placu ljudi trebaju graditi, možda u vasioni.
In a video address he asked on whose plot people should build, maybe in outer space.
Direktor UIO-a Zoran Tegeltija je član SNSD-a, a na to mjesto ga je postavio Dodik.
UIO director Zoran Tegeltija is a member of SNSD, and Dodik appointed him to that post.
U Upravnom odboru UIO-a je i ministar finansija Srđan Amidžić, koji je također kadar SNSD-a.
Finance minister Srđan Amidžić, who is also an SNSD official, is on the UIO management board too.
UIO je ranije objasnio da zakon priznaje samo kupovinu gotove kuće ili stana.
The UIO explained earlier that the law only recognises the purchase of a finished house or flat.
Ako zemljište ostaje vlasništvo građanina, firma može naplatiti samo usluge gradnje.
If the land remains the citizen's property, the company can only charge for construction services.
Za povrat PDV-a bi zemljište prije prodaje trebalo preći u vlasništvo firme koja gradi kuću.
For a VAT refund, the land would have to become the property of the company building the house before the sale.

title: Danska gradi novu ekipu nakon propuštenog Svjetskog prvenstva
Denmark is building a new team after missing the World Cup
body: Danska, protivnik BiH u baražu Lige nacija, pravi novu ekipu nakon velikog neuspjeha.
Denmark, Bosnia and Herzegovina's opponent in the Nations League play-off, is building a new team after a big failure.
Danci se nisu plasirali na Svjetsko prvenstvo, iako su deset godina igrali na svim velikim turnirima.
The Danes did not qualify for the World Cup, although they had played at every major tournament for ten years.
U finalu baraža u Pragu igrali su 2:2 s Češkom, a izgubili su nakon penala.
In the play-off final in Prague they drew 2:2 with Czechia, and lost after penalties.
Savez je ipak zadržao selektora Briana Riemera, čiji ugovor traje do Eura 2028.
The federation still kept head coach Brian Riemer, whose contract runs until Euro 2028.
Nekoliko važnih igrača je otišlo, među njima Simon Kjær i golman Kasper Schmeichel.
Several important players have left, among them Simon Kjær and goalkeeper Kasper Schmeichel.
Christian Eriksen nije igrao od juna, ali Riemer kaže da vrata za njega nisu zatvorena.
Christian Eriksen has not played since June, but Riemer says the door is not closed for him.
U Ligi nacija Danska je pobijedila Portugal u Bragi 4:1, ali je dva puta izgubila od Norveške.
In the Nations League Denmark beat Portugal 4:1 in Braga, but lost twice to Norway.
Riemer želi napadački nogomet, a u svojih prvih 20 utakmica tim je dao 44 gola.
Riemer wants attacking football, and in his first 20 matches the team scored 44 goals.
Slaba tačka je odbrana, jer selektor često igra rizično.
The weak point is the defence, because the coach often plays with risk.
Danska televizija TV 2 je objavila da je Danska dobila najbolji mogući žrijeb.
Danish broadcaster TV 2 reported that Denmark got the best possible draw.
Prva utakmica igra se u Zenici, a revanš u Danskoj.
The first match is played in Zenica, and the return leg in Denmark.

title: Sjećanje na 2003: Noć kada je Koševo plakalo
Remembering 2003: The night Koševo cried
body: BiH i Danska su se 2003. godine već sastale u utakmici koja je bila kao baraž.
Bosnia and Herzegovina and Denmark already met in 2003 in a match that was like a play-off.
Bilo je to 11. oktobra, u posljednjem kolu kvalifikacija za Euro 2004. u Portugalu.
It was on 11 October, in the last round of qualifiers for Euro 2004 in Portugal.
Pobjeda na Koševu bi BiH direktno odvela na Evropsko prvenstvo.
A win at Koševo would have taken Bosnia and Herzegovina directly to the European Championship.
Stadion je bio pun, a prodano je 40.000 ulaznica.
The stadium was full, and 40,000 tickets were sold.
Danska je povela u 12. minuti, kada je Martin Jørgensen pogodio pored golmana Kenana Hasagića.
Denmark took the lead in the 12th minute, when Martin Jørgensen scored past goalkeeper Kenan Hasagić.
U 39. minuti Hasan Salihamidžić je centrirao, a Elvir Bolić je glavom izjednačio na 1:1.
In the 39th minute Hasan Salihamidžić crossed, and Elvir Bolić equalised with a header to make it 1:1.
BiH nije uspjela dati drugi gol, iako je Danac Thomas Gravesen pred kraj dobio crveni karton.
Bosnia and Herzegovina did not manage to score a second goal, although the Dane Thomas Gravesen got a red card near the end.
Danska je tako direktno otišla na Euro, a BiH je u grupi završila četvrta.
Denmark thus went directly to the Euro, and Bosnia and Herzegovina finished fourth in the group.
Navijači su nakon utakmice napustili stadion u suzama.
After the match the fans left the stadium in tears.
Sada se ekipe ponovo sastaju, u martu u baražu Lige nacija.
Now the teams meet again, in March in the Nations League play-off.

title: Liga nacija: Hrvatska igra s Irskom, Španija s Francuskom
Nations League: Croatia plays Ireland, Spain plays France
body: UEFA je danas u Nyonu izvukla sve parove baraža i četvrtfinala Lige nacija.
UEFA today drew all the play-off and quarter-final pairs of the Nations League in Nyon.
Utakmice se igraju u martu 2027. godine, a svaki par igra dvije utakmice.
The matches are played in March 2027, and each pair plays two matches.
Najveći derbi je meč između Španije i Francuske.
The biggest clash is the match between Spain and France.
U baražu za Ligu A BiH igra s Danskom, a Mađarska sa Srbijom.
In the play-off for League A, Bosnia and Herzegovina plays Denmark, and Hungary plays Serbia.
Hrvatska igra protiv Irske, a Slovenija protiv Velsa.
Croatia plays against Ireland, and Slovenia against Wales.
U baražu za Ligu B Sjeverna Makedonija igra s Kiprom, a Rumunija s Estonijom.
In the play-off for League B, North Macedonia plays Cyprus, and Romania plays Estonia.
U četvrtfinalu Norveška igra s Engleskom, Holandija s Portugalom, a Belgija s Njemačkom.
In the quarter-finals Norway plays England, the Netherlands play Portugal, and Belgium plays Germany.
Pobjednik para Španija – Francuska igrat će u polufinalu protiv Norveške ili Engleske.
The winner of the Spain – France pair will play in the semi-final against Norway or England.
Prve utakmice su od 25. do 27. marta, a revanši od 28. do 30. marta.
The first matches are from 25 to 27 March, and the return legs from 28 to 30 March.
Prema pravilima UEFA-e, tim iz jače lige igra revanš na svom stadionu.
According to UEFA rules, the team from the stronger league plays the return leg at its own stadium.

title: BiH u baražu Lige nacija igra protiv Danske
Bosnia and Herzegovina will play Denmark in the Nations League play-off
body: Nogometna reprezentacija BiH igrat će protiv Danske u baražu za mjesto u Ligi A.
The Bosnia and Herzegovina football team will play Denmark in the play-off for a place in League A.
Žrijeb je danas održan u švicarskom gradu Nyonu, gdje se nalazi sjedište UEFA-e.
The draw was held today in the Swiss town of Nyon, where UEFA has its headquarters.
Utakmice se igraju krajem marta 2027. godine.
The matches will be played at the end of March 2027.
Prva utakmica bit će 25. ili 27. marta, a revanš 28. ili 30. marta.
The first match will be on 25 or 27 March, and the return leg on 28 or 30 March.
Pobjednik će u narednom izdanju igrati u Ligi A, a poraženi tim ide u Ligu B.
The winner will play in League A in the next edition, and the losing team goes to League B.
Danska je u svojoj grupi Lige A bila treća, dok je BiH u grupi Lige B završila druga.
Denmark finished third in its League A group, while Bosnia and Herzegovina finished second in its League B group.
Revanš uvijek igra kod kuće tim iz Lige A, zato Zmajevi prvi meč igraju kod kuće.
The League A team always plays the return leg at home, so the Dragons play the first match at home.
Ovo će biti peti i šesti službeni meč između ove dvije reprezentacije.
These will be the fifth and sixth official matches between these two national teams.
U kvalifikacijama za Svjetsko prvenstvo 1998. obje ekipe su slavile na svom terenu.
In the qualifiers for the 1998 World Cup, both teams won at home.
BiH je 2003. godine pobijedila u Kopenhagenu 2:0, ali je na Koševu igrala samo 1:1.
In 2003 Bosnia and Herzegovina won 2:0 in Copenhagen, but only drew 1:1 at Koševo.
UEFA je zabranila dolazak navijača BiH na prvu gostujuću utakmicu, pa u Danskoj neće biti domaćih navijača.
UEFA has banned Bosnian fans from the first away match, so there will be no Bosnian fans in Denmark.

title: Split otkazao novogodišnji koncert Dine Merlina
Split cancels Dino Merlin's New Year concert
body: Koncert Dine Merlina, koji je bio planiran za 30. decembar na splitskoj Rivi, neće se održati.
Dino Merlin's concert, which was planned for 30 December on Split's Riva, will not take place.
Odluku je na pres-konferenciji objavio gradonačelnik Splita Tomislav Šuta.
Split mayor Tomislav Šuta announced the decision at a press conference.
Koncert je bio dio adventskog programa u gradu.
The concert was part of the city's Advent programme.
Šuta je rekao da lično nije potpisao ugovor jer je situacija otišla u pogrešnom smjeru.
Šuta said that he personally did not sign the contract because the situation had gone in the wrong direction.
Više od 20.000 građana potpisalo je peticiju protiv koncerta.
More than 20,000 citizens signed a petition against the concert.
Oni su tražili da grad novac da za novi medicinski aparat za bolnicu u Splitu.
They asked the city to give the money for a new medical device for the hospital in Split.
Grad je dan ranije objavio da bi Merlin dobio 140.000 eura, a produkcija bi koštala 160.000 eura.
A day earlier the city announced that Merlin would get 140,000 euros, and the production would cost 160,000 euros.
Gradonačelnik sada kaže da je to bila samo procjena, jer javna nabavka nije bila završena.
The mayor now says that this was only an estimate, because the public procurement was not finished.
Rekao je i da mu je žao ljudi koji su već rezervisali smještaj u Splitu.
He also said that he feels sorry for the people who had already booked accommodation in Split.
Dino Merlin i njegov menadžment još nisu komentarisali odluku.
Dino Merlin and his management have not yet commented on the decision.

title: Teleskop Euclid snimio više od milijardu objekata u svemiru
The Euclid telescope has recorded more than a billion objects in space
body: Evropska svemirska agencija ESA objavila je prve velike podatke teleskopa Euclid.
The European Space Agency ESA has published the first large data set from the Euclid telescope.
Teleskop je za 13 mjeseci snimio više od milijardu objekata u svemiru.
In 13 months the telescope recorded more than a billion objects in space.
Euclid je lansiran u julu 2023. godine, a podaci pokrivaju dio neba velik kao 9.500 punih mjeseci.
Euclid was launched in July 2023, and the data covers a part of the sky as big as 9,500 full moons.
Među objektima je više od 900 miliona galaksija i više od 60 miliona mogućih kvazara.
Among the objects are more than 900 million galaxies and more than 60 million possible quasars.
Kvazari su vrlo svijetli centri dalekih galaksija.
Quasars are very bright centres of distant galaxies.
Teleskop je pronašao i oko 15.000 gravitacijskih leća, kada bliža galaksija savija svjetlost dalje galaksije.
The telescope also found about 15,000 gravitational lenses, when a nearer galaxy bends the light of a more distant galaxy.
Pomogli su kompjuterski programi i hiljade volontera.
Computer programs and thousands of volunteers helped.
Ovi podaci su osnova za najveću 3D mapu svemira, koja će pomoći u proučavanju tamne materije i tamne energije.
This data is the basis for the largest 3D map of the universe, which will help in studying dark matter and dark energy.
Naučnica Natalie Lines rekla je da se sada može izmjeriti masa pojedinih galaksija.
Scientist Natalie Lines said that the mass of individual galaxies can now be measured.
Do sada je snimljeno oko 14 posto neba, a novi podaci očekuju se sredinom 2027. godine.
So far about 14 percent of the sky has been recorded, and new data is expected in mid-2027.

title: Četiri jednostavna testa za zdravlje mozga kod kuće
Four simple tests for brain health at home
body: Neki jednostavni testovi kod kuće mogu pokazati kako stari naš mozak.
Some simple tests at home can show how our brain is ageing.
O tome piše magazin BBC Science Focus, a stručnjaci kažu da testovi ne mogu zamijeniti pregled kod doktora.
The magazine BBC Science Focus writes about this, and experts say that the tests cannot replace an examination by a doctor.
Neurolog David Sharp iz Londona kaže da biološka starost mozga nije uvijek ista kao godine osobe.
Neurologist David Sharp from London says that the biological age of the brain is not always the same as a person's age.
Prvi test je brzina hoda, a mjeri se koliko sekundi treba za 4 metra.
The first test is walking speed, and you measure how many seconds you need for 4 metres.
Žene od 40 do 49 godina u prosjeku hodaju 1,39 metara u sekundi, a muškarci 1,43.
Women aged 40 to 49 walk 1.39 metres per second on average, and men 1.43.
Drugi test mjeri vrijeme reakcije na internetu, a ono kod odraslih sporo raste svake decenije.
The second test measures reaction time online, and in adults it slowly increases every decade.
Treći test je crtanje puta od kuće do prodavnice ili kafića napamet.
The third test is drawing the route from home to a shop or café from memory.
Stručnjakinja Anna-Katharine Brem kaže da su problemi s orijentacijom jedan od ranih znakova Alzheimerove bolesti.
Expert Anna-Katharine Brem says that problems with orientation are one of the early signs of Alzheimer's disease.
Četvrti test je Cognitron, online test od oko 30 minuta koji su uradili više od 500.000 ljudi.
The fourth test is Cognitron, an online test of about 30 minutes that more than 500,000 people have done.
Na rezultate utiču san, stres i raspoloženje, zato je važno pratiti promjene kroz vrijeme.
Sleep, stress and mood affect the results, so it is important to follow changes over time.

title: Grijanje u Banjoj Luci moglo bi poskupjeti za 52 posto
Heating in Banja Luka could become 52 percent more expensive
body: Gradska toplana Eko toplane traži da cijena grijanja u Banjoj Luci poraste za 52 posto.
The city heating company Eko toplane is asking for the price of heating in Banja Luka to rise by 52 percent.
Kompanija od grada traži i dodatnih 12 miliona KM godišnje iz budžeta.
The company is also asking the city for an extra 12 million KM a year from the budget.
Bez toga, kako upozorava, sistem ne može stabilno raditi.
